title: nldd pattern
description: The structured part of a pattern, in src/patterns/<slug>/<slug>.pattern.yaml. The tree on the page and in the skill is drawn from it.

partial.description: Examples that show only a part of the pattern, so they may leave out what is required.

or.description: Other tags that can take its place.

slot.description: The slot it sits in. A list means any of them. Without a tag, the node is the slot itself.

label.description: A place in the tree that is no single element.

attrs.description: Attributes worth naming here. `name="value"` is a fixed value, and the node then only means elements with that value. A slot goes in `slot`.

one-of.description: Attributes of which at most one applies.

any-of.description: Tags that can fill a `label` or `slot`. The list is never complete.

note.description: What the node is for, in a few words.

optional.description: The pattern also holds without it.

flat.description: Children are a sequence, drawn without tree lines.
